variants.on_screen_text: YOUR AI NEEDS A KILL SWITCH
variants.on_screen_subtext: Bound it. Log it. Stop it.
variants.post_caption:
An unbounded AI agent can keep spending, sending, or changing data after you look away. But a bounded agent gives you one clear result you can inspect and one switch that stops the next action. Before you delegate a workflow, write down the objective, permission boundary, and stop condition. #AIAgents #AIControls #Automation
